liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Help>Slipknot>Franklin's is very long; the band labors over the first Slipknot riff, and Jerry seems to blame Bob; Set two opens with an energetic Unbroken Chain into Help, Slipknot and Franklin's [9][14]
- **Corinna** (2 reviews): The Corinna>Mathilda pairing is singled out as good; Reviewer picks the Corinna>Mathilda as the second set highlight [9][11]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Jack Straw sloppy [11]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Reviewer judges this the best late-era Mexicali Blues ever played [11]
- **Unbroken Chain** (1 review): Reviewer complains Jerry does not tear into the Unbroken Chain jam as he had at other shows [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mathilda**: rare: 7 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-03-29.akg451.jensen.8835.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 194 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1995-03-29.136874.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 20 songs; 171 min; rated 3.4/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd95-03-29.naks.georges.30516.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 12 songs; 118 min; rated 2.85/5 by 19 [6]
- **gd95-03-29p.sbd.18096.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 50 min; rated 3.39/5 by 17 [8]. Said about its sound: Phil's ear monitor recording has the bass turned way up and Bob barely audible [19]

## Around the show

- An ear monitor recording captures Jerry apparently pinning blame on Bob during the Slipknot riff trouble [9]
- The band keeps the crowd waiting a long time before opening set two with The Chain [10]
- Coming out of space, the band teases St. Stephen, and Jerry nods to the crowd as if to say wait [14]
- Reviewer says Jerry was engaged and present at this show [18]
- The monitor feed picks up band conversation that never went through the PA [19]
- Reviewer considers it the best show of the Omni run and among the best of the tour [14]
- Reviewer rates it the best show of the Omni run, strong for 1995, with few lyrical flubs [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-03-29.akg451.jensen.8835.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Tyler Jenson; source: Taper's source unknown other than A:D and AKG 451's [1]
- **gd1995-03-29.136874.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) [2]. Also: Soundboard version of the show, with the first few seconds of the encore missing [2]
- **gd95-03-29.naks.georges.30516.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by cweir; source: Audience: Nakamichi 300's (Set 2 only) [6]. Also: Set two taped with NAK300 microphones into a Teac DAP-20, then transferred via Zoltrix and CoolEdit; SBE errors fixed with shntool [6]
- **gd95-03-29p.sbd.18096.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Marc Pujol; source: Partial Soundboard [8]. Also: Partial second set from Phil's ear monitor feed, taken from a crew member's cassette recorded inside the venue; Second-generation cassette played on a Kenwood deck, captured at 96kHz/24bit, with very slight hiss reduction, then converted to 44.1/16 SHN [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1995-03-29 Wed The Omni, Atlanta, GA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1252769875948/grateful-dead-1995-03-29-wed-the-omni) [26]
